kit bumped 2.28.0 -> 2.70.3, all 5 advisories resolved (verified: none apply to 2.70.3 per bun audit cross-checked with real semver). The CardReview.test.ts regression that blocked this was root-caused: not a kit bug, but kit's enhance() becoming spec-correct (now passes event.submitter to FormData) exposed that the test was clicking the <span> inside the button rather than the button itself -- fixed by switching to getByRole('button', {name}) in CardReview.test.ts. 59/59 tests pass, build clean, svelte-check unchanged (27/1 baseline).

happy-dom bumped 14.12.3 -> 20.13.2 alongside the kit bump (remfo-l1t) since the two interact -- happy-dom 20.x's stricter/more spec-correct click-to-submit handling is what surfaced the CardReview.test.ts selector bug. All advisories resolved (verified: none apply to 20.13.2). 59/59 tests pass.

vitest 2.1.9 -> 5.0.0, @vitest/ui in lockstep. Required a vite bump too (vitest 5 needs vite's ./module-runner export, vite 6+) -- done together with remfo-xbf. Advisory resolved, verified clean. 59/59 tests pass.

vite 5.3.4 -> 7.3.6, plus the vite-ecosystem plugins that needed bumping in lockstep: @sveltejs/vite-plugin-svelte 3.1.1 -> 6.2.4, @sveltejs/enhanced-img -> 0.11.0, @vite-pwa/sveltekit -> 1.1.0, vite-plugin-pwa -> 1.3.0. This combined with the vitest bump (remfo-30j) surfaced two real regressions, both fixed:
1. A duplicate zod resolution (top-level 3.25.76 vs a nested 4.5.4 pulled in to satisfy sveltekit-superforms's optional zod peer) made TypeScript see two structurally-incompatible ZodObject types -- fixed with a package.json 'overrides' pinning zod to 3.25.76 everywhere.
2. tsconfig.json's compilerOptions.types listed the bare '@testing-library/jest-dom' package (the Jest global-augmentation entry point), which doesn't match vitest 5's restructured Assertion type and broke every toBeInTheDocument()-style matcher across all *.test.ts files. Fixed by pointing it at the '@testing-library/jest-dom/vitest' subpath instead (the correct one for a vitest project -- vitest-setup.ts already imports it too, so the tsconfig entry was redundant on top of being wrong).
All advisories resolved and verified clean. 59/59 tests, clean build, svelte-check back to the exact pre-existing 27/1 baseline (verified same file:line set, not just same count), dev server starts and serves 200.

postcss 8.4.39 -> 8.5.27. Did not resolve automatically from the vite bump as guessed in the original issue -- needed its own explicit bump. Advisory resolved, verified clean. Tests/build/check all pass.

Since cypress was confirmed unused (no npm script, never run, wrong tool for no-JS testing per the original issue), removed cypress, cypress.config.ts, cypress/, and the eslint.config.js cypress files block. This also cleared the transitive js-yaml/extract-zip/cross-spawn/uuid/qs advisories that were riding along with it. bun run test (59/59), build, check (unchanged 27/1 baseline) all pass.
